title: 3 blood sugar swaps
caption:

heygen_prompt: Vertical 9:16 food commercial, warm natural daylight, Indian home kitchen, slow smooth camera moves, no people's faces, absolutely no text, letters, logos or captions anywhere in the frame. Shot 1 (0-3s): close-up of a wooden spoon lifting fluffy brown rice from a steel bowl, gentle steam. Shot 2 (3-6s): a small block of golden jaggery being broken on a wooden board, crumbs falling in slow motion. Shot 3 (6-10s): overhead of small bowls filled with millets, pumpkin seeds and sunflower seeds on a rustic table, a hand sprinkles seeds. Shot 4 (10-15s): a neat kraft-paper grocery box filled with whole grains, millets, seeds and jaggery on a kitchen counter, soft light, slow push-in. Calm, fresh, appetising, earthy colour palette.
